function.name: click
function.description: Click on a specific location on the screen

x.description: Coordinate on the x axis to click.

y.description: Coordinate on the y axis to click.

function.name: long_press
function.description: Long press on a specific location on the screen.

x.description: Coordinate on the x axis to long press.

y.description: Coordinate on the y axis to long press.

function.name: input_text
function.description: Write text inside of an already selected text field, typically this is preceeded by a 'click' action that selects a field on the screen to type into.

text.description: The text to input in the field.

function.name: scroll
function.description: Scroll a fixed amount in a specific direction.

function.name: navigate_home
function.description: Navigate to the home screen from the current screen you are on.

function.name: navigate_back
function.description: Navigate back to the previous page.

app_name.description: The name of the application to open.

function.name: wait
function.description: Wait for a fixed amount of time. This is useful when you need to 'await' the results of a page that is still loading.

function.name: status
function.description: Once you have completed the work required to fulfill an instruction, report your status by calling this function with 'successful'. If you find that a task is impossible to complete,  call this with 'infeasible' after finding that information.

goal_status.description: The status of the completion of a instruction, either 'successful' or 'infeasible', called to conclude an episode.
